sourceReviewNotes: All 12 paper pages, 20 scheme pages and 27 generated source figures visually read. Nine first-occurrence SymbolMT glyphs checked against the rendered source.
100 separately practicable tasks; 40/40 census leaves covered. Raw ask scan: 99 lines, with four narrative/diagram-label lines exempted and retained in context.

SEC archive returned HTTP 403 for the marking scheme. The unmodified SEC document was obtained from https://thephysicsteacher.ie/Exam%20Material/LC%20Physics/pdf/Higher%20Level/Marking%20Schemes/2014.pdf and every page reviewed.

All ten Q5 parts, both Q5(j) options, both complete eight-task Q11 passages and all four 28-mark Q12 alternatives retained. Internal any-N responses keep every accepted choice and the published stepped tariff.

All experiment readings and assumptions retained: four momentum measurements; seven refraction pairs including the intended 23-degree outlier; resonance length and diameter; six current-temperature pairs and initial temperature.

Golf trolley and launch geometry, laser diffraction, nuclear reactor, touchscreen, strain-gauge bridge, PET and silicon passages, spring motion, convex mirror, ice calorimetry and falling-magnet figures retain required data and labels.

Graph drawing and explanation, and heat-exchanger operation and necessity, are separate published tasks with only their own question sentence. Common criteria and complete alternative answer routes retain the correct tariff.

Nuclear equations, critical-angle formula and four-term heat balance retain original scheme solution crops. Historical uranium-to-plutonium equation retains the SEC wording and penalty alongside a visible clarification that two electron antineutrinos are omitted by the historical scheme; beta-decay check: https://www.energy.gov/science/doe-explainsbeta-decay.

All 2803 prior authored records, 1425 prior Higher runtime blocks, the complete Ordinary runtime file, 518 prior figures and 24 prior audit records remain unchanged. All 279 other subject deck/authored files remain byte-identical.
Atlas links include original reference topics, reviewed omissions and required older-course headings for each question; the runtime crosswalk was regenerated.
